_comment: In-repo held-out-style conceptual tasks. Every query is a genuine
paraphrase: it shares no content token with the target's identifier,
docstring, summary, or path, enforced by
2026-08-19 (R-005) after an independent checker found the previous
queries were near-verbatim copies of their own docstrings, which made
this a docstring-substring test rather than a paraphrase test.
This is not conceptual-v1 and may not be used to retire that suite.

tasks.query: Where does the code define the scale of certainty for a result?
What prevents a performance number from being assumed valid on any computer?
Which interface must a fresh audit satisfy so all of them can be driven identically?
Where is the faster-than-naive routine for combining two numeric grids constructed?
What chains the processing steps so they execute one after another?
Which module implements the GraphQL subscription transport?
